projectDescription: Trepzy is a financial technology platform that unifies cross-border receiving, holding, and moving of value — letting individuals and businesses manage international finances in one place.
keyFeatures: Global Account — multi-currency accounts (USD, EUR, BRL) for receiving and holding international value
Cross-border orchestration — coordinated receiving, currency exchange, and local transfers in one experience
Identity verification — KYC and KYB flows for individuals and businesses before financial services are unlocked
Authorization framework — digital signatures, delegated wallet access, and multi-approver workflows for businesses
Operation tracking — real-time status of every step from initiation to completion, with clear pending states
Separation of personal and business accounts — one login, multiple distinct account contexts
Partner-backed infrastructure — BlindPay for banking/digital-value rails, Pods as secondary Pix path
publicApiSurface: Conta Trepzy — the primary account relationship between a customer and Trepzy
Global Account — currency-specific sub-account (USD, EUR, BRL) with its own receiving details and balance
Receiving details — account data provided to the payer to route an incoming transfer
Authorization request — the workflow where a user confirms an outgoing operation
Digital signature — technical proof linking a user's approval to a specific instruction on a digital network
Delegated wallet access — pre-authorized permission for a service to sign operations under defined conditions
KYC flow — identity verification steps for individual customers
KYB flow — verification steps for business customers including representative and ownership checks
Operation status — the live state of any in-progress or completed transaction (pending, completed, failed)
Team permissions — role-based access controls governing which team members can view, prepare, or approve operations
